title: Gap-aware fixed-M005 development reconstruction — 2015 pilot then 2015-2019
objective: Perform the first governed quantitative reconstruction of frozen M005 on verified OANDA development evidence, freezing three-state gap semantics before outcomes: 2015 four-pair integration pilot first, then unchanged 2015-2019 reconstruction.
success_criteria: Bound RND-0032/RND-0033 evidence identities gate every evaluated shard
Frozen M005 uses MA20/MA50, vol12 ddof=0, threshold 0.0005, fixed sessions, one-bar delay and three-observed-bar minimum hold
Signals use midpoint observations while execution uses real bid/ask closes
Any observed M5 discontinuity resets indicator and delayed-signal state but never silently erases an existing economic position
Post-gap signal state remains unavailable until freshly warmed from contiguous genuine observations; pending pre-gap signal is cancelled
Missing nominal bars never count toward minimum hold; gap exposure and elapsed wall time are explicit
Four-pair 2015 technical pilot must pass before the unchanged engine may evaluate 2016-2019
Only 2015-2019 development evidence can produce strategy outcomes
Outputs expose event/trade/gap evidence and concurrent unit-normalized portfolio accounting without capital allocation or optimized sizing
No portfolio ranking, strategy search, promotion or execution authority is introduced
stop_conditions: Any strategy search, tuning, ranking, Champion-filter evaluation or discovery
Any strategy outcome access for 2020 or later
Any validation or reserved-final-test signal/performance access
Any synthetic/interpolated/forward-filled candle or synthetic spread
Any broker write, capital authority, automatic promotion or automatic merge
Any silent indicator/delayed-signal continuation across a data gap or any silent erasure of an open economic position
Any full 2015-2019 performance run before the 2015 technical pilot gate passes
